protocol.title: Computational Prediction of Protein Interactions in Single Cells by Proximity Sequencing
protocol.platform: Proximity Sequencing (Prox-seq) combined with single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq)
cell_lines: Jurkat (human T cell leukemia; T cell marker panel)
Raji (human Burkitt lymphoma B cell line; B cell marker panel)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous quantification of mRNA, surface protein expression, and protein complexes (dimers) at the single-cell level using dual-antibody proximity ligation assay (PLA) with DNA-conjugated probes, sequenced alongside scRNA-seq cDNA libraries; computational benchmarking of iterative, linear regression (LR), and ensemble methods for proximity noise removal and protein complex prediction

platform_details.assay_type: Proximity Ligation Assay (PLA) with sequencing readout
platform_details.probe_design: Each target protein is stained with two DNA-conjugated antibodies: Probe A and Probe B. Ligation of Probe A oligo to Probe B oligo occurs only when the two probes are within 50-70 nm of each other (i.e., when their target proteins are co-localised or in complex).
platform_details.pla_product: Ligated A+B oligo barcode pair; counted by unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) after sequencing
platform_details.free_oligo_modification: An experimentally modified Prox-seq procedure adds FreeOligoA and FreeOligoB (non-antibody-conjugated oligos) to measure non-proximal (unligated) probe counts. These counts are used as explanatory variables in the LR and ensemble methods for proximity noise estimation.
platform_details.sequencing_platform: Combined scRNA-seq + PLA product library (sequenced together)
platform_details.umi_counting: PLA product UMI counts per cell per protein pair extracted computationally (Python3/Anaconda3 v4.10.3)

cells.jurkat: Jurkat T cells; cultured under standard conditions; resuspended in PBS for staining
cells.raji: Raji B cells; cultured under standard conditions; resuspended in PBS for staining

buffers.PBS: Phosphate-buffered saline; used for cell suspension and wash steps
buffers.blocking_buffer: Blocking buffer to reduce nonspecific antibody binding prior to probe staining; incubated 10 min at 4 C
buffers.wash_buffer: PBS-based wash buffer; used 3x after each probe staining step to remove unbound probes
buffers.ligation_buffer: Ligation buffer compatible with T4 DNA ligase proximity ligation reaction
buffers.stop_solution: Stop solution to quench T4 DNA ligase activity after ligation

probes.probe_A: Prox-seq Probe A: DNA-conjugated antibody panel targeting CD3, CD28, PD1, CD147, ICAM1, PDL1, HLADR, B7 (same panel used for Jurkat and Raji arms; ref Vistain et al. Nat Methods 2022)
probes.probe_B: Prox-seq Probe B: DNA-conjugated antibody panel targeting same proteins as Probe A; B oligo is the ligation partner for A oligo
probes.free_oligo_A: FreeOligoA: non-antibody-conjugated oligo dispensed alongside probe panel; generates PLA product Protein_X:free_oligo_B to measure non-proximal Probe A counts
probes.free_oligo_B: FreeOligob: non-antibody-conjugated oligo dispensed alongside probe panel; generates PLA product free_oligo_A:Protein_Y to measure non-proximal Probe B counts
probes.isotype_control: Isotype control antibody with oligonucleotide conjugation; included in both Probe A and Probe B panels; used to estimate nonspecific antibody binding probability directly from observed PLA data (paper Section 2.2, S4 Fig)

reagents.ligation_enzyme: T4 DNA Ligase; catalyses ligation of Probe A and Probe B oligos when within 50-70 nm proximity

library_reagents.dna_library_buffer: DNA library preparation buffer; used to generate combined cDNA (gene expression) and PLA product sequencing library
library_reagents.sequencing_reagent: Sequencing reagent for combined scRNA-seq + Prox-seq library

probe_panel.control: Isotype control antibody (oligo-conjugated) in both Probe A and Probe B panels

proximity_noise_model.definition: Random ligation of Probe A and Probe B oligos from non-interacting protein molecules that are sufficiently close by random chance; main background source in Prox-seq

variables.R: Cell radius (5 um = 5000 units in simulation)
variables.A_i: Non-proximal Probe A count for protein i
variables.B_j: Non-proximal Probe B count for protein j

proximity_noise_model.distribution: Binomial; X_ij ~ Binomial(n = A_i * B_j, p = d_ligation^2 / 4R^2)
proximity_noise_model.overdispersion: Negative binomial (NB) variance added in simulation (n_NB = 1.5) to capture real data overdispersion
proximity_noise_model.note: Proximity noise scales quadratically with protein abundance and ligation distance (Fig 2e)

iterative_method.mechanism: Iteratively solve quadratic equations for all protein dimers; protein complex count = observed PLA count minus expected random PLA count
iterative_method.strengths: Performs well in high signal-to-noise (homodimer or heterodimer only) scenarios
iterative_method.limitations: Unstable with multiple protein dimers or overabundant proteins; sensitive to initialisation
iterative_method.applicable_situations: Simpler biological scenarios with only homodimers or only heterodimers

lr_method.mechanism: Weighted least squares regression of observed PLA count onto product of non-proximal Probe A and Probe B counts; protein complex count = observed PLA count minus estimated proximity noise (beta_1 * A_i_prime * B_j_prime); requires free oligo modification
lr_method.strengths: Performs well in low signal-to-noise and complex multi-dimer scenarios
lr_method.limitations: Unstable when non-proximal probe counts are near zero; not optimal for high signal-to-noise homodimer/heterodimer-only scenarios
lr_method.applicable_situations: Low signal-to-noise and scenarios with multiple protein dimers or overabundant proteins

ensemble_method.mechanism: Apply LR method first; use LR output as initialisation for iterative method; bridges both approaches
ensemble_method.strengths: Robust and consistent across all biological scenarios; lowest false positive rate; best overall prediction score
ensemble_method.limitations: Requires free oligo modification experimental procedure
ensemble_method.applicable_situations: Robust choice when true biological conditions are uncertain; recommended default

fishers_exact_test.mechanism: One-sided Fisher's exact test on 2x2 contingency table of PLA counts; Benjamini-Hochberg correction; identifies protein complexes occurring at higher frequency than random
fishers_exact_test.use: Statistical validation of complex enrichment; complementary to quantification methods

prediction_score.formula: Score = w1 * SumPearson - w2 * SumMeanDeviation - w3 * SumFPrate
prediction_score.result: Ensemble method has highest average prediction score and lowest variance across all 800 randomised simulation scenarios (S10d Fig, S2 Table)

steps.name: Cell suspension preparation
steps.notes: Resuspend Jurkat T cells in PBS at appropriate concentration for single-cell Prox-seq staining

steps.name: Nonspecific binding block
steps.notes: 10 min blocking at 4 C; reduces nonspecific antibody binding background. Paper Section 2.2: nonspecific binding constitutes <1% of both-specific PLA counts for extracellular proteins (e.g. CD147:CD147 in Jurkat cells, S4 Fig)

steps.name: Probe A staining with isotype control
steps.notes: 30 min incubation at 4 C. Probe A panel targets CD3, CD28, PD1, CD147, ICAM1, PDL1, HLADR, B7. Isotype control antibody (oligo-conjugated) included in Probe A panel to directly define nonspecific binding distribution

steps.name: Wash unbound Probe A (3x)
steps.notes: 3x PBS wash, 2 min each. Removes excess unbound Probe A antibodies. Unligated probes do not contribute to PLA signal (library prep and alignment require barcodes from both A and B probes)

steps.name: Probe B staining
steps.notes: 30 min incubation at 4 C. Probe B panel targets same proteins as Probe A. After this step, cells carry both Probe A and Probe B antibodies on surface proteins

steps.name: Wash unbound Probe B (3x)
steps.notes: 3x PBS wash, 2 min each

steps.name: Free oligo addition (non-proximal probe measurement)
steps.notes: 10 min incubation at 4 C. FreeOligoA and FreeOligoB added to measure non-proximal (unligated) probe counts. Free oligos are not conjugated to antibodies; they produce PLA products Protein_X:free_oligo_B (non-proximal Probe A) and free_oligo_A:Protein_Y (non-proximal Probe B). Required for LR and ensemble methods (Methods: LR method equation Y_ij = X_ij - beta_1 * A_i_prime * B_j_prime). Ref [4] Vistain et al. Nat Methods 2022.

steps.name: Proximity ligation reaction
steps.notes: 30 min at 25 C. T4 DNA Ligase catalyses ligation of Probe A oligo to Probe B oligo only when within 50-70 nm. Random co-localisation generates proximity noise: E(X_ij) = (d_ligation^2 / 4R^2) * A_i * B_j. BioScript mix abstraction represents the proximity ligation event.

steps.name: Ligation stop and wash (3x)
steps.notes: Add stop solution to quench ligase; 3x PBS wash to remove ligation reagents before library preparation

steps.name: Single-cell encapsulation and library preparation
steps.notes: Cells encapsulated in individual droplets and lysed. mRNA captured by poly-dT oligonucleotides; PLA products captured by barcoded sequences. Combined cDNA and PLA product library prepared at 37 C for 30 min. Sequencing reagent added for final library preparation (10 min mix).

steps.name: Jurkat library QC detection
steps.notes: QC check on Jurkat Prox-seq library: fragment size, complexity, UMI diversity (abstracted from fluorometric/electrophoretic QC e.g. Bioanalyzer, Qubit)

steps.name: Cell suspension preparation
steps.notes: Resuspend Raji B cells in PBS. Raji cells express ICAM1 (known homodimer), HLADR, PDL1, B7. Raji cells do not express CD3 or PD1; their PLA products for those targets are near zero, validating probe panel specificity

steps.name: Nonspecific binding block
steps.notes: Same blocking procedure as Jurkat arm

steps.name: Probe A staining with isotype control
steps.notes: Same panel as Jurkat arm. ICAM1:ICAM1 homodimer signal in Raji cells exceeds expected random ligation background (Fig 5d-f)

steps.name: Wash unbound Probe A (3x)
steps.notes: 3x PBS wash, 2 min each

steps.name: Probe B staining
steps.notes: Same procedure as Jurkat arm

steps.name: Wash unbound Probe B (3x)
steps.notes: 3x PBS wash, 2 min each

steps.name: Free oligo addition (non-proximal probe measurement)
steps.notes: Same free oligo modification as Jurkat arm. Non-proximal probe counts for Raji cells used to calibrate proximity noise in LR and ensemble methods for Raji-specific protein complex detection

steps.name: Proximity ligation reaction
steps.notes: 30 min at 25 C. Same conditions as Jurkat arm. ICAM1:ICAM1 homodimer signal in Raji cells exceeds E(X_ij) proximity noise baseline

steps.name: Ligation stop and wash (3x)
steps.notes: Add stop solution; 3x PBS wash

steps.name: Single-cell encapsulation and library preparation
steps.notes: Same procedure as Jurkat arm. After sequencing, UMI counts per PLA product per single Raji cell are primary data for computational analysis (iterative / LR / ensemble methods)

steps.name: Raji library QC detection
steps.notes: Same QC procedure as Jurkat arm

simulation_model.description: Physical model of PLA product formation per single cell; simulates proximity noise and protein complex signal independently
simulation_model.variance_model: Negative binomial (NB); n_NB = 1.5; p_NB = (1 + A_i / n_NB)^-1
simulation_model.calibration: Calibrated against Jurkat (T cell) and Raji (B cell) experimental data; NB variance chosen from mean n_NB fitted to real PLA products (S3c Fig)
simulation_model.posterior_predictive_checks: Mann-Whitney U statistic and coefficient of variation comparison between simulated and real data (S3a, S3b Fig)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Jurkat cell prep, blocking, Probe A staining, wash x3, Probe B staining, wash x3, free oligo addition, ligation, stop+wash x3, library prep, library QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(jurkatLibSignal); Raji cell prep, blocking, Probe A staining, wash x3, Probe B staining, wash x3, free oligo addition, ligation, stop+wash x3, library prep, library QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(rajiLibSignal); experiment ends; data to computational pipeline

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 sequential if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in s (seconds) or m (minutes); BioScript does not support h token
bioscript_compiler_notes.compiler_behaviour_note: lilott8/BioScript compiler maps both dispose and drain to a unified disposal IR operation (dispose in IR for both pass and fail branches). This does not affect compilation correctness. Observed in bsbbif_3_f (Jurkat fail path) and bsbbif_6_f (Raji fail path) of the IR output.
bioscript_compiler_notes.arms: Two sequential arms encoded in main BB (Jurkat ARM 1) and jurkatLibJoin BB4 (Raji ARM 2). Each arm is structurally identical: blocking -> Probe A stain -> wash x3 -> Probe B stain -> wash x3 -> free oligo addition -> ligation -> stop+wash x3 -> library prep -> QC detect.
